lessons.title: The Alphabet: A to E
lessons.summary: Learn the sound, shape and Braille dots of the first five letters.

cards.heading: Meet the letters
cards.text: The English alphabet has 26 letters. In this lesson you will learn the first five: A, B, C, D and E. Each card gives you the sound, an example word, the shape of the letter, and its Braille dots.

cards.heading: The letter A
cards.text: A says "ah" as in apple. Shape: two slanted lines that meet at the top, with a bar across the middle. Braille: dot 1.

cards.heading: The letter B
cards.text: B says "buh" as in ball. Shape: a straight line on the left with two bumps on the right. Braille: dots 1 and 2.

cards.heading: The letter C
cards.text: C says "kuh" as in cat. Shape: an open curve, like a crescent moon. Braille: dots 1 and 4.

cards.heading: The letter D
cards.text: D says "duh" as in dog. Shape: a straight line on the left with one big bump on the right. Braille: dots 1, 4 and 5.

cards.heading: The letter E
cards.text: E says "eh" as in egg. Shape: a straight line with three short bars pointing right. Braille: dots 1 and 5.

lessons.title: Greetings
lessons.summary: Say hello, please, thank you and goodbye.

cards.heading: Hello
cards.text: Hello! How are you? You can answer: I am fine, thank you.

cards.heading: Good morning
cards.text: Say good morning before noon. Say good afternoon after noon. Say good evening when the sun goes down.

cards.heading: Please and thank you
cards.text: Say please when you ask for something. Say thank you when someone helps you. The answer to thank you is: you are welcome.

cards.heading: Goodbye
cards.text: Say goodbye when you leave. You can also say: see you tomorrow, or take care.

lessons.title: Sounds Around Us
lessons.summary: Listen for everyday sounds and learn the words for them.

cards.heading: Listen closely
cards.text: Many words are sounds we hear every day. Close your eyes and listen to the world around you.

cards.heading: Animal sounds
cards.text: A dog barks. A cat meows. A rooster crows in the morning. A bird sings.

cards.heading: Weather sounds
cards.text: Rain patters on the roof. Thunder rumbles. Wind whistles through the trees.

cards.heading: Home sounds
cards.text: A door creaks. A kettle whistles. A clock ticks. A phone rings.

lessons.title: Words You Can See
lessons.summary: Match simple words to what they look like.

cards.heading: Reading by sight
cards.text: Every word has a shape you can learn to recognize. Look at the word, then picture the object it names.

cards.heading: Sun
cards.text: Sun is a short word with three letters: S, U, N. The sun is a bright yellow circle in the sky.

cards.heading: Book
cards.text: Book has four letters: B, O, O, K. A book is a stack of pages with a cover. You read it.

cards.heading: House
cards.text: House has five letters: H, O, U, S, E. A house has walls, a roof, a door and windows. People live in it.
